title: Evaxion will present new immune data for personalized cancer vaccine EVX-01 at the SITC 2026 Annual Meeting
author: Na
description: Evaxion will present new immune profiling data from its phase 2 trial of personalized cancer vaccine EVX-01 combined with pembrolizumab at the SITC 2026 Annual Meeting in November. The data will showcase systemic immunomodulatory effects beyond vaccine-specific T-cell responses. Previous two-year data showed a 75% objective response rate in advanced melanoma patients, with 92% still responding at two-year follow-up and no relapses observed.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Merck's pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) is being used as a combination partner in the trial. While the combination shows positive results, Merck is mentioned only as a collaborator/supplier of the anti-PD-1 therapy, not as the primary focus of the announcement.

Company is presenting promising clinical data with strong efficacy results (75% ORR, 92% durable response at 2 years with no relapses). The expansion of presentations at major conferences and progression to three-year data demonstrates advancement of their lead asset EVX-01, indicating positive clinical progress and investor confidence.

title: Evaxion presents new preclinical data for cytomegalovirus vaccine program EVX-V1
author: Not Specified
description: Evaxion announced new preclinical data supporting its multi-component cytomegalovirus (CMV) vaccine candidate EVX-V1, which combines AI-discovered antigens with optimized established antigens. The data demonstrates potential to improve control of acute infection, latency, and viral reactivation. EVX-V1 represents a scalable strategy for rational vaccine development across herpesviruses, addressing a significant unmet medical need as no CMV vaccine is currently licensed despite affecting 60-70% of adults in developed countries.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company presented encouraging preclinical data supporting its lead vaccine candidate EVX-V1, demonstrating potential efficacy in controlling CMV infection across multiple mechanisms (acute infection, latency, and reactivation). The data represents meaningful progress toward addressing a significant unmet medical need in a large market ($474.6M in 2023, growing at 6.6% CAGR), with no competing licensed vaccines currently available.

title: Evaxion receives Prix Galien UK Award for Best digital health solution
author: Na
description: Evaxion A/S received the 2026 Prix Galien UK Award for Best Digital Health Solution for its AI-Immunology™ platform, which uses artificial intelligence to develop novel vaccine candidates for cancer and infectious diseases. This marks the company's second recognition from the Galien Prix Foundation in less than a year, validating the platform's capabilities in vaccine target discovery and development.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company received a prestigious industry award recognizing its AI-Immunology™ platform as the best digital health solution. This is the second major recognition from the Galien Prix Foundation in less than a year, demonstrating strong external validation of the company's technology and innovation in vaccine development. The award highlights the platform's effectiveness in target discovery and clinical application.

title: Evaxion presents new preclinical data for EVX-04, an off-the-shelf therapeutic vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia
author: Na
description: Evaxion announced positive preclinical data for EVX-04, an off-the-shelf therapeutic vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia (AML). The vaccine successfully expresses and secretes in human cells, drives specific immune responses across different human immune profiles, and induces targeted cell-killing. The company is preparing regulatory filings for clinical testing and will present the data at the European Hematology Association Congress in Stockholm on June 13, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company announced successful preclinical data demonstrating EVX-04's complete expression, secretion in human cells, and ability to drive specific immune responses with targeted cell-killing potential. The vaccine shows promise as an effective therapeutic cancer vaccine, and the company is advancing toward clinical testing with regulatory filings in preparation.

title: Evaxion promotes Birgitte Rønø to joint role of Chief Scientific and Chief Operating Officer
author: Not Specified
description: Evaxion A/S announced the promotion of Birgitte Rønø to serve as both Chief Scientific Officer and Chief Operating Officer, reflecting her extensive contributions to the company's operations and scientific expertise. The move is intended to enhance external engagement and strategy execution while strengthening the company's ability to communicate its AI-Immunology™ platform capabilities to partners and investors.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The promotion of an experienced internal executive to a dual leadership role demonstrates organizational stability and confidence in management. The restructuring is framed as strategic to enhance external visibility and execution of the company's vaccine development strategy, suggesting positive momentum in the company's operations and market positioning.
